info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Document Directory Validation-spec
info.description: The Document Directory Validation API is designed to streamline the validation process of document directories in the banking domain. This API allows users to submit requests for validating document directories, ensuring compliance with required standards and regulations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers working on document management systems. By integrating this API, businesses can automate validation checks, reduce errors, and enhance operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create validation for a specific document directory.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create validations for the document directory identified by RES-100045. It ensures that the necessary checks are performed before the document directory is utilized further in the application.
